description: Save an interest for the user in plain words, e.g. "trail running shoes under 80 euro" or "Lego Technic at least 30% off": Lowbird then alerts them and fills their deals feed. Use it when the user wants to hear about deals on a kind of product ("avvisami quando…", "cerco…"). Requires signing in.
